headline: Toyota launches tender offer to buy up to 108,750,841 shares at 2,725 yen.
key_facts: Tender offer price is 2,725 yen per share, a 10% discount to the 3,028 yen closing price on 2026-11-04 (the lower of that closing price and the one-month average of 3,030 yen).
Tender offer period runs from 2026-11-06 to 2026-12-07 (21 business days).
Planned purchase is 108,750,741 shares (0.92%); the maximum is 108,750,841 shares (0.92%).
The board on 2026-11-05 expanded the 2026-08-04 buyback cap from 500,000,000 shares to 610,000,000 shares and from 1 trillion yen to 1.3 trillion yen.
The tender offer is to be funded entirely from own funds, with 296,359 million yen needed for the purchase.
stated_purpose: To acquire treasury shares from the Expected Tendering Shareholders (Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance and Sompo Japan), who are policy-holding shareholders reducing their holdings, through a tender offer. The filing states the aim is to support further capital efficiency improvement, including EPS and ROE, and to offer a price at a discount to market, which market purchases or off-auction trades could not provide. The shares acquired are planned to be cancelled at the end of the quarter in which the buybacks under the 2026-08-04 and 2026-11-05 board resolutions are completed.
